C1: a D-0008 gated golden proof (golden-financial.db.test.ts, cloning composed-relation.db.test.ts) seeds the six 0016 cases via IngestionRepository (packed per period; reload via a second replaceBudgetBatch proving CHANGED-answer attribution) and asserts EXACT numeric(18,2) values + the % text against a frozen fixture via a strict by-field loader. C2: composedCtes projects, on the OUTER query, row-aligned source_presence (CASE on the FULL OUTER JOIN side), the deterministic Budget-Components label set, and the active actuals/budget batch ids per month via ingest_batch correlated subqueries (ingest_batch added to objectsTouched, validator re-allow-listed); SelectionExecutor gathers these into a (source,period,batchId) tuple set + label set + per-row presence, surfaced on the extended Provenance type via chat.service (the reporting epic renders it). Updates the task-2 hermetic tests for the objectsTouched + row-shape change; array-typed columns asserted via raw pool.query. No new endpoint, warehouse object, or measure change.

in-query composed provenance (row-aligned source_presence, label set, active batch ids via ingest_batch in objectsTouched)

criteria_map.a golden-answer reconciliation fixture a: KEEP. A frozen golden-answer fixture + strict by-field loader asserts EXACT composed-relation values across all six decision-0016 cases (matched / Budget-only zero-fill / Actual-only zero-fill / duplicate-multi-cost-centre no-fan-out / reload-active-swap with CHANGED-answer attribution / %-edges) as a D-0008 host proof.
criteria_map.provenance for every governed number car: KEEP (surfaced here, human-decided). Provenance is captured IN the composed query - row-aligned source-presence, the deterministic Budget-Components label set, and the active source batch ids as (source,period,batchId) tuples (ingest_batch added to objectsTouched) - gathered by SelectionExecutor and surfaced on the EXTENDED Provenance type via chat.service; the reporting epic renders it.

gaps: The objectsTouched change is outside the declared test scope: adding ingest_batch breaks the exact assertions in sqlBuilder.composed.test.ts and sqlValidator.composed.test.ts, neither of which was in write_scope; a new provenance test does not repair those existing hermetic failures.

C2 was not technically specified at the query boundary: the outer SELECT emits only requested dims/measures, so adding provenance inside financial_relation alone does not put it on result rows, and putting it on the outer query needs defined aggregate semantics (presence sets, sorted label sets, (source,period,batchId) tuples - not bare ids that lose the period key for month/YTD aggregates).

The task contradicted the approved story plan's surface ownership: the story plan assigns contract/src/api.ts + chat.service.ts provenance construction to this story, the current Provenance type has no batch/presence/label fields, and no earlier task owns them - so deferring the API surface left C2 with no owning consumer.

The reload proof could not demonstrate the decision's attribution: the draft asserted the reload answer is unchanged, but 0016 requires active batch ids so a reload's CHANGED answer is attributable to the swap - a valid proof needs distinct prior/replacement budget, unchanged actuals, changed Budget/% output, the prior id inactive, and the new id returned in the same query.

The fixture state model was underspecified: replace*Batch deactivates EVERY prior active batch for that source/period, so seeding each case via replace*Batch would erase prior same-period cases unless periods are isolated or all concurrent cases are packed into one batch; and runtime-generated UUID batch ids cannot be asserted literally from frozen JSON.

The loader's paise-only format conflicted with the percentage output: Actual/Budget are numeric(18,2) but the % returns text ('0.5'), null, or labels, so the fixture schema must distinguish money decimals from the percentage union by field or it rejects valid output or silently changes the out-of-scope measure.
resolutions: Added backend/src/sql/sqlBuilder.composed.test.ts and backend/src/sql/sqlValidator.composed.test.ts to write_scope (the objectsTouched + row-shape change mechanically alters their exact assertions); composed-relation.db.test.ts is also updated for the new row shape.

Specified the query boundary: the provenance columns are ADDED to the OUTER projection (ride on every row); provenance is captured at the composed relation's natural (gl_code, month) grain (scalar presence, one active actuals + one active budget per source/period), and SelectionExecutor gathers the per-row batch ids into a SET of (source, period, batchId) TUPLES + the union of label sets, with per-row source_presence on ResultTable rows; coarser YTD/aggregate rollup is the reporting epic.

HUMAN-decided (round): WIRE the API provenance surface HERE (honouring the story plan) - extend the Provenance type (contract/src/api.ts) + populate it in chat.service.ts + thread the payload through SelectionExecutor - so C2 has an owning consumer; the reporting epic only renders it. All four files are in write_scope.

Redefined case 5 as the 0016 attribution proof: a second replaceBudgetBatch with a DISTINCT Budget value - the Budget/% output CHANGES, the prior budget batch goes inactive, actuals are untouched, and the NEW budget batch id is returned in the same query (no 'answer unchanged' assertion for the reloaded side).

Specified the fixture-state model: PACK the matched / Budget-only / Actual-only / multi-cost-centre cases as DISTINCT gl_codes inside ONE actuals batch + ONE budget batch per period; drive reload via a second replaceBudgetBatch; the frozen JSON holds the EXACT numeric values + expected source-presence + label sets, never the UUIDs, and batch ids are compared to the ids RETURNED by replace*Batch.

The loader validates BY FIELD TYPE: money fields paise-exact ^-?\d+\.\d{2}$, the % field a UNION (a decimal-ratio string OR null OR one of the two labels), and a COMPLETE six-case set; its reject-malformed/incomplete path is tested hermetically.
open_items: Coarser YTD/aggregate-row provenance rollup and the trust-strip RENDERING are the reporting epic.
Budget-label->SAP-cost-centre mapping master + roll-over measure + multi-plant remain deferred.
